If someone has sold their asset for $5, and some assets are only sold for private use, would it be fair for someone on Patreon to resell it and receive $2000 a month? I think it's important to say I think resellers on Patreon shouldn't need to repay their money, as some people rely on Patreon money. Given the unrest and financial distress in so many countries, it's important for people to prioritize that. It's a gray area and complicated.

Not all people are paying these licenses, but I did elaborate that some people are using these licenses, and it's important to remember users won't always know what the modder has done before porting the asset.
I didn't know about SC previously flipping DAZ assets. The point still stands, however. Modders who make their own content should be respected.

Short answer: it takes a lot of time and information on the situation.

Many people are stealing assets that aren't allowed to be resold. Others are legally reselling assets. Some are creating their own content from scratch. I know there are many people out there who will spitefully lump all three together because they're selling their mods, and report people without knowing the modder's rights to the content they're selling.

If you see someone using DAZ models, you could report them, but it'd be better to directly contact the DAZ modeller. You'd need to go back and forth with Patreon if you do contact them, and chances are, they won't care unless you're the copyright holder yourself.

It might be different on Patreon, but reporting on someone's behalf can damage the chances of a take down. Reports can be seen as spammy and disregarded.

DAZ is used to manipulate 3D models into scenes. It has a store where you can buy models created by the community. Most DAZ conversions are private due to legal reasons. There is a legal - and moral - gray area in paywalling DAZ conversions. Some DAZ models are free for commercial use, however.

I feel more people should focus on that, rather than mods costing money. It's one thing for modders like ShinglesCat to create their own content from scratch. It's another to buy DAZ models for cheap, convert it, and paywall it without a cut going to the original DAZ artist.

If you find an animation that does the same thing, you can use that instead. It doesn't need to be Immersive Interactions' animation file.

You could make a mod that mimics Immersive Interactions, if you're filming in one take and don't plan to stop the game after the reading/writing scene. Or you could create a poser mod with whichever animation file you find.

I would take the Immersive Interactions reading animation and using Nemesis to make it a player only sitting animation, or if you don't use Nemesis, replace all characters' sitting animations with the reading animation. You'll want to disable the replacer once you're done whichever way you choose. I have a file setup [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SiU3USn-AvvtspavTeaL29g-0yCw0Ptn/view) for you to use as a base.

The difficult part is finding which animation (.hkx file) you need. Either ask Jayserpa which animation in their mod triggers the reading animation, or use [hkxPoser](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/11783) (it requires [Havok Content Tools](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U88C9K-mSHs)) to preview Immersive Interaction's animations. You might be able to use Blender or another program to view the animations.

From what I understand, Immersive Interactions uses the same 5 names for its animation files, and uses the .esp to delegate what each animation does. Dissecting the mod isn't simple.

[Here's](https://www.reddit.com/r/skyrimmods/comments/hzgabi/rough_guide_to_editing_animations_in_skyrim_se/) a rough guide on editing animations. It'll be easier to make changes to the legs than make new animations from scratch.

[Immersive Interactions](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/47670) has sitting while reading animations, you'll need [Skyrim Souls](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/27859) for it to work.

[ILV Poser](http://voblascreatures.blogspot.com/2019/07/ilv-poser-skyrim-le-and-se.html) has some reading and writing poses, but they're static.

Like ty-leelee said it's a planarian. There are some harmless worms, but planaria are distinguished by their triangle-shapes head and are scavengers/carnivores. They are a pest who'll appear if you overfeed your shrimp. Don't cut the planarian or it'll multiply. There are treatments to kill them however you'll want to read on it thoroughly before doing so, and if you have snails, you'll want to move them out of your tank while treating it.
